description: This Swift source file provides a utility function to migrate legacy user defaults keys to a new namespace by prefixing them with 'openclaw.'. It operates by iterating through existing user defaults and renaming keys if they match the legacy prefix and the new key does not already exist.

methods.name: migrateLegacyDefaults
methods.description: Migrates user defaults with legacy prefix 'openclaw.' to a new preference namespace by renaming keys with the prefix 'openclaw.'.
